title_protection.quote: It shall be deemed prima facie evidence of practicing podiatry within the meaning of ORS 677.805 to 677.840 if any person uses the name or title podiatrist, podiatric physician and surgeon, chiropodist, D.S.C., D.P.M., D.P., foot expert, foot specialist, foot correctionist, or any other word, abbreviation or title indicating that the person was or is qualified and licensed to practice podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct unbecoming a person licensed to practice medicine or podiatry, or detrimental to the best interests of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional or dishonorable conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing any person to solicit patients for the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing any person to solicit patients for the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition can be cured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition of sickness, disease or injury can be cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently divulging a professional secret without the written consent of the patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently divulging a professional secret without the written consent of the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense punishable by incarceration in a Department of Corrections institution or federal prison.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any offense punishable by incarceration in a Department of Corrections institution or in a federal prison, subject to ORS 670.280.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment as defined in ORS 676.303.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment as defined in ORS 676.303.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license to practice in this state, or in connection with applying for or procuring registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about the licensee's skill or efficacy of treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making statements that the licensee knows, or with the exercise of reasonable care should know, are false or misleading, regarding skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment or remedy prescribed or administered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another licensee or permitting any person to use the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another licensee licensed under this chapter or permitting or allowing any person to use the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine or podiatry by a person not licensed by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine or podiatry by a person not licensed by the board, when the licensee knows, or with the exercise of reasonable care should know, that the person is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a professional designation in untruthful or deceptive advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the name of the licensee under the designation "doctor," "Dr.," "D.O." or "M.D.," "D.P.M.," "Acupuncturist," "P.A." or any similar designation in any form of advertising that is untruthful or is intended to deceive or mislead the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in the practice of medicine or podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in the practice of medicine or podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapacity to practice medicine or podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incapacity to practice medicine or podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state of a license to practice, based upon similar acts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action by another state of a license to practice, based upon acts by the licensee similar to acts described in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to designate the degree appearing on the license as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to designate the degree appearing on the license under circumstances described in ORS 677.184 (3).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violating any provision of this chapter or any rule adopted by the board, board order, or failing to comply with a board request pursuant to ORS 677.320.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report the change of the location of practice as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report the change of the location of practice of the licensee as required by ORS 677.172.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imprisonment as provided in ORS 677.225.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Imprisonment as provided in ORS 677.225.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a fraudulent claim.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a fraudulent claim.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing psychosurgery.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing psychosurgery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing an invitation for an informal interview with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing an invitation for an informal interview with the board requested under ORS 677.415.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the federal Controlled Substances Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the federal Controlled Substances Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate medical purpose or without following accepted procedures.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate medical purpose, or prescribing controlled substances without following accepted procedures for examination of patients, or prescribing controlled substances without following accepted procedures for record keeping.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse actions taken by another licensing jurisdiction or peer review body.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by the licensee to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing jurisdiction or any peer review body, health care institution, professional or medical society or association, governmental agency, law enforcement agency or court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the board of voluntary resignation from health care institution staff while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by the licensee to notify the board of the licensee's voluntary resignation from the staff of a health care institution or voluntary limitation of a licensee's staff privileges at the institution if that action occurs while the licensee is under investigation

definition_quote.value: The diagnosis or the medical, physical or surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons directly attached to and governing the function of the foot and ankle, except treatment involving the use of a general or spinal anesthetic unless the treatment is performed in a hospital licensed under ORS 441.025 or in an ambulatory surgical center licensed by the Oregon Health Authority and is under the supervision of or in collaboration with a podiatric physician and surgeon; and Assisting in the performance of surgery, as provided in ORS 677.814.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" means: (A) The diagnosis or the medical, physical or surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons directly attached to and governing the function of the foot and ankle, except treatment involving the use of a general or spinal anesthetic unless the treatment is performed in a hospital licensed under ORS 441.025 or in an ambulatory surgical center licensed by the Oregon Health Authority and is under the supervision of or in collaboration with a podiatric physician and surgeon; and (B) Assisting in the performance of surgery, as provided in ORS 677.814.

methods_authorized.quote: The diagnosis or the medical, physical or surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons directly attached to and governing the function of the foot and ankle

drug_authority.value: Podiatric physicians and surgeons are included as 'dispensing physicians' authorized to purchase and dispense prescription drugs to patients; and as supervising physicians for physician assistants who may prescribe and administer controlled substances.
drug_authority.quote: "Dispensing physician" means a physician or podiatric physician and surgeon who purchases prescription drugs for the purpose of dispensing them to patients or other individuals entitled to receive the prescription drug and who dispenses them accordingly.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The diagnosis or the medical, physical or surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons directly attached to and governing the function of the foot and ankle

amputation_authorized.quote: "Podiatry" does not include administering general or spinal anesthetics or the amputation of the entire foot.

anesthesia_authority.quote: except treatment involving the use of a general or spinal anesthetic unless the treatment is performed in a hospital licensed under ORS 441.025 or in an ambulatory surgical center licensed by the Oregon Health Authority and is under the supervision of or in collaboration with a podiatric physician and surgeon

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgery of the ankle as defined in ORS 677.805 must be conducted: (1) In a hospital or in an ambulatory surgical center licensed by the Oregon Health Authority under ORS 441.025; and (2) By a podiatric physician and surgeon who meets the qualifications for ankle surgery established by rule of the Oregon Medical Board.

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgery of the ankle as defined in ORS 677.805 must be conducted: (1) In a hospital or in an ambulatory surgical center licensed by the Oregon Health Authority under ORS 441.025

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: "Supervising physician" means a physician licensed under ORS 677.100 to 677.228, or a podiatric physician and surgeon licensed under ORS 677.805 to 677.840, who supervises a physician assistant.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: "Supervising physician" means a physician licensed under ORS 677.100 to 677.228, or a podiatric physician and surgeon licensed under ORS 677.805 to 677.840, who supervises a physician assistant.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: ORS 677.805 to 677.840 do not prevent: (a) Any person, firm or corporation from manufacturing, selling, fitting or adjusting any shoe or appliance designed and intended to equalize pressure on different parts of the foot.

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: A podiatric physician and surgeon may assist in performing surgery on any part of the body.
